focusAreas.description: The KB this run extends or restructures. 3 files: SKILL.md (139 lines), principles.md (141 lines, zero code blocks), patterns-and-anti-patterns.md (220 lines, 2 code blocks).
focusAreas.evidence: principles.md covers 8 principles: (1) Separate server state from client state; (2) Colocate, then lift; (3) Accessibility is a baseline, not a feature; (4) Performance budgets are concrete numbers; (5) Progressive enhancement; (6) Error boundaries scoped to recovery; (7) Type the contract; (8) Choose the framework's grain. SKILL.md docstring explicitly states 'no platform partner KB (frontend platforms vary widely: React, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose).'
focusAreas.relevance_to_feature: Sets the baseline content the new KBs must extend without duplicating; sets the voice and prose-style precedent; explicitly rejects the paired-platform shape — the per-layer Design stage must justify any deviation.
focusAreas.current_behavior: Covers backend-of-the-frontend material (state, perf, errors, typing, framework grain) and accessibility-as-baseline. Does NOT cover anti-slop, UX flow, UI/visual specifics, design-system architecture, atomic/headless/compound/slot component patterns, or Storybook. Code-block density: 0.8 / 100 lines (lowest of any KB in the project).

focusAreas.description: Three existing platform KBs: KB-cc-platform (9 files, 2624 lines), KB-github-actions-platform (20 files, 6719 lines), KB-codespaces-platform (11 files, 2052 lines). Voice is senior-engineer-handbook per the PRD's AC-FR-6-a target.
focusAreas.evidence: KB-cc-platform SKILL.md frontmatter: 'name: kb-cc-platform; description: Platform knowledge for Claude Code — Anthropic's agentic CLI ... covers configuration, architecture, and extension mechanisms ... Pairs with KB-cc-design which adds the design discipline (when to choose which primitive). This KB is the PLATFORM half: facts, syntax, configuration, and lookup chains.' Code-block density: 2.2 / 100 lines.
focusAreas.relevance_to_feature: Template for KB-storybook-platform structure (SKILL.md + references/ with topical splits); template for voice; documents the design/platform pairing semantics relevant to whether storybook-platform needs a sibling design KB (it does not — design discipline for Storybook is the consumer's responsibility, not Storybook's).
focusAreas.current_behavior: Each platform KB has 8-20 reference files organized topically (architecture, extensions, configuration, workflows, integrations). SKILL.md is the index/router; references carry deep content. Code-block density 2.2-4.1 / 100 lines — platform-KB content uses code where syntax is the knowledge.

focusAreas.description: Codified across KB-cc-design's patterns-and-anti-patterns.md (the canonical KB-authoring discipline) and verified by codebase inspection.
focusAreas.evidence: Convention: SKILL.md frontmatter has name (kebab-case matching directory; KB- prefix per ADR-0019), description (multiline YAML, 6-12 lines, explains when the KB is loaded), allowed-tools (typically Read/Grep/Glob; platform KBs may add Edit/Write/WebFetch). references/ holds H2-organized deep content. Each SKILL.md and each reference file leads with '## Contents' checklist. Design KBs document 'When this KB is loaded' subsection.
focusAreas.relevance_to_feature: Sets the structural template for KB-storybook-platform and any new design-side KBs. No structural surprises expected for new content authoring.
focusAreas.current_behavior: All 17 existing KBs conform to this convention. The 3 platform KBs (cc, github-actions, codespaces) each have the design/platform-pairing language. The convention is mature and well-policed by auditing-skills checks.

focusAreas.area_name: Anthropic's official frontend-design skill (external authoritative reference)
focusAreas.description: The skill at /mnt/skills/public/frontend-design/SKILL.md is Anthropic's canonical anti-slop discipline. Single SKILL.md, ~40 lines, with the LICENSE.txt sibling. Discovered during external research for T-001.
focusAreas.evidence: Skill names explicit anti-slop signatures: 'NEVER use generic AI-generated aesthetics like overused font families (Inter, Roboto, Arial, system fonts), cliched color schemes (particularly purple gradients on white backgrounds), predictable layouts and component patterns, and cookie-cutter design that lacks context-specific character.' Names five aesthetic dimensions: Typography, Color & Theme, Motion, Spatial Composition, Backgrounds & Visual Details.
focusAreas.relevance_to_feature: This is the most authoritative possible source for T-001's anti-slop discipline. The new KB content can cite this skill directly. Note: it is at /mnt/skills/public/, not inside the project's .claude/skills/ — it is read-only and version-managed by Anthropic.
focusAreas.current_behavior: Available at preload to any Claude session via /mnt/skills/public/frontend-design/. Treated as external authoritative knowledge — does not become part of this project's .claude/skills/ but is cited by the new KB content.
